social_circle.name: Valentina Restrepo

demographics.occupation: Social worker at a nonprofit serving immigrant families
demographics.education: BSW, Florida International University; MSW, San Francisco State University

background.how_they_met: Cousins by birth — daughter of Alicia's maternal aunt; grew up visiting each other's families in Sacramento and Miami during summers and Christmases.
background.why_close: Bonded as teens over being the only Colombian-American girls in their respective schools; grew tighter after Valentina's own messy Miami breakup drove her to move to Oakland three years ago, putting her within driving distance of Chico; both processed relationship implosions in parallel.

interests: weekend hiking when she visits Chico
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Rapid-fire bilingual (Spanglish) voice memos — roughly 40 a week — with occasional long texts when something serious hits. Uses Colombian slang ('parcera', 'que nota'), heavy emoji, sends voice notes mid-cooking or mid-commute. Audio-first over typed messages.

shared_activities: Daily voice-memo exchanges on WhatsApp
Long weekends at Alicia's Chico apartment roughly every 2 months (couch-crashing)
Co-cooking Colombian dishes (sancocho, bandeja paisa) when together
Joint FaceTime calls to abuela Lucía in Medellin
Debriefing dating life and post-divorce recalibration
recent_text_topics: Planning the summer Colombia trip together to visit abuela Lucía, including flight timing and what gifts to bring.
Processing news of Daniel's (ex-husband) remarriage that hit Alicia back in October — Valentina was a primary support during that bad-Saturday stretch.
Valentina's own new relationship with a public-defender she started seeing two months ago; asks Alicia whether she's 'moving too fast.'
Ongoing running joke about Tío Hernán's Fresno Thanksgiving politics and how to survive the next family gathering.
Checking in on Ben (Alicia's casual boyfriend) — Valentina is skeptical-but-supportive and wants updates after every date.

social_circle.name: Priya Raman

demographics.occupation: Senior data scientist at a mid-size analytics firm
demographics.education: BS Statistics, UC Davis (2018); MS Data Science, UC Berkeley (2020)

background.how_they_met: Met freshman year at UC Davis in an introductory CS course; bonded as two of the few women of color in the track and became study partners, then roommates junior year.

interests: cooking South Indian and experimental fusion food

shared_activities: Weekly Tuesday-night video-call dinners (both cooking on their respective ends)
Occasional weekend visits — Priya has driven up to Chico in emergencies, most recently after the Daniel-remarriage news
Joint hikes at Table Mountain and Bidwell Park when visiting
Paper/grant-proposal editing swaps
Co-attending the occasional Bay Area conference or workshop
recent_text_topics: Menu planning for the upcoming Tuesday dinner — Priya is teaching Alicia a proper sambar, Alicia is teaching arepas with aji amarillo pork.
Alicia's new diffusion-model-for-narrative research architecture; Priya is reading the draft and flagging statistical concerns.
Processing the aftermath of the October remarriage news and checking in on Alicia's sleep and alcohol patterns (Priya was the one who called that Saturday night).
Planning a weekend visit to Table Mountain and sancocho cook-along for late spring.
South Asian progressive group's upcoming fundraiser — Priya asked Alicia to donate a generative-art print for the auction.

social_circle.name: Elena Gonzalez

demographics.occupation: Retired pediatric nurse (retired ~3 years ago from a nonprofit pediatric clinic in Sacramento)
demographics.education: Associate's degree in Nursing (RN), Sacramento City College

background.how_they_met: Mother-daughter; Elena emigrated from Medellin in the late 1980s and gave birth to Alicia in Sacramento about a year after arrival.
background.why_close: Elena passed down Colombian cultural traditions (cumbia/vallenato Sunday cooking, home remedies, Catholic ritual that Alicia now observes culturally) and has done quiet emotional work around race and her daughter's divorce; one of the first family members to disclose her own postpartum depression after Alicia's GAD diagnosis opened the door.

key_traits: a careful listener who has 'been doing the work' on race and mental health
interests: Catholic devotionals and Christmas Eve mass
personality_mini_profile.communication_style: WhatsApp family group chat plus 1:1 WhatsApp thread. Bilingual but leans Spanish, mixes in voice notes, frequent photos of food, long voice memos after mass on Sunday. Uses emoji lightly — mostly hearts, flowers, and the praying-hands.

shared_activities: Monthly last-Sunday lunch in Sacramento (Alicia drives down the 99)
WhatsApp family group chat with dad Rafael, Mateo, Valentina, and abuela Lucía
Joint FaceTimes with abuela in Medellin every other Sunday
Christmas Eve mass and Día de los Muertos candle lighting
Recipe exchange — Elena coaches the Sunday batch-cooking and sancocho
social_circle.communication_frequency: daily (short WhatsApp messages and voice notes); in-person ~monthly
recent_text_topics: Coordinating the next last-Sunday lunch in Sacramento and what Alicia should bring.
Updates on abuela Lucía's post-stroke recovery and planning the summer Medellin trip; Elena is deciding whether to join for part of it.
Rafael's (dad's) blood-pressure medication refill and his latest cardiologist check; Elena uses Alicia as an informal second opinion.
Gentle check-ins about therapy with Dr. Patel and whether Alicia is sleeping ('¿estás durmiendo, mija?').

social_circle.name: Sofia Delgado
social_circle.relationship: close Chico friend; Chico Outdoor Club organizer

demographics.occupation: Parks and recreation program coordinator for the City of Chico; organizes Chico Outdoor Club hikes as a volunteer
demographics.location: Chico, CA (lives in the Chapmantown neighborhood)
demographics.education: BS Environmental Science, Humboldt State University (2014)

Post-hike coffee at Naked Lounge or tacos at La Cocina de Chuy
Amateur soccer league in the summer (pickup games at Hooker Oak)
Wildfire-season check-ins (AQI reports, mask sharing, air-purifier swaps)
Occasional gallery-opening plus-one when Marcus has a show
